notes: Texas Business Source uses a BBN-NET CGI search system. The search form at texasbusinesssource.com/searchsellers.html submits to bbn-net.com. All 51 listings are returned on a single page when submitting an empty search with SHOW=100. Listings contain detailed financial data including asking price, revenue, cash flow, inventory, FFE, and down payment. Location and business type are combined in the category field and would need post-processing to separate. Listing descriptions are truncated in the table view.
